llm.summary: This skill is a coherent diagram-generation helper that uses AnyGen's remote service and CLI as disclosed, with some privacy and consent considerations for sensitive diagram content.

dimensions.detail: Network access, CLI execution, and an API key are proportionate to a remote diagram-generation integration, and no unrelated local file scanning, destructive actions, or hidden data collection are present in the artifact.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: It instructs users to install a dependent anygen-workflow-generate skill and use AnyGen CLI commands; this is purpose-aligned, though the install command shown is broad and should be reviewed before execution.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill discloses server-side rendering through www.anygen.io, but it does not add a prominent confirmation step before sending diagram descriptions that may include sensitive architecture or business-process details.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill suggests API key login and environment-variable configuration, which may persist credentials in the user's shell or CLI configuration, but this is disclosed and directly tied to the service integration.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is to convert text descriptions into flowcharts, architecture diagrams, and similar visuals, and the requested read/exec tools fit the documented CLI-based workflow.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Before installing, make sure you are comfortable sending diagram prompts to AnyGen's remote service, especially if they describe internal systems or business processes. Review any CLI install or authentication command before running it, and store API keys only in places you trust.
llm.findings:
[SQP-2] expected: The artifact repeatedly states that diagrams are rendered on www.anygen.io, so remote processing is expected for the stated purpose; the finding is best treated as user guidance because a clearer privacy warning would reduce accidental sharing of sensitive content.
[SQP-1] expected: The skill's activation and CLI use are broad but aligned with the diagram-generation purpose; there is no artifact-backed hidden or unrelated automatic execution, though explicit confirmation before installs, auth, or remote rendering would improve control.
